channel.title: Mitesh Gandhi | Reflections
channel.description: Reflections from an optometrist on seeing people, turning points, and where the science of the eye meets the inner life.

item.title: The tree of life in the eye
item.description: Every day I look into the eye and see an optic disc, branching vessels, a cross behind the eyes. Science explains the how. Meditation lets me wonder at the why.
